authority_note: This queue coordinates work; linked decisions and handoffs grant authority.

required_capabilities: List every operating-system, runtime, service, and external capability
required_software: List every product, component, version, source, and integrity rule
required_privileges: List every standard, elevated, service, and human-only boundary
human_actions: List every Product Owner interaction and private-input boundary
environments: List build, test, staging, clean-room, and production environments
preflight_checks: Provide one read-only command or inspection for every prerequisite
fallback_routes: Define an approved route or explicit no-fallback result for each failure
unresolved: Replace with every unresolved prerequisite before execution

authorization_envelopes.activation_rule: Chief of Staff may activate the next covered task only after its predecessor is accepted and all task preflight checks pass

tasks.title: Replace with the first bounded task
scope: Replace with the exact permitted work
exclusions: Replace with work that must not be performed
acceptance_criteria: Replace with an independently checkable outcome
stop_conditions: Stop on authorization, identity, scope, readiness, or evidence mismatch

execution.environment: Name the exact environment and identity boundary
required_capabilities: List task-specific capabilities already proven by the readiness packet
required_software: List exact task-specific software and versions
human_actions: State none or list the exact human action and privacy boundary
preflight_checks: List commands that must all pass before mutation
execution.activation_condition: Readiness is ready, authority exists, dependencies are accepted, and task preflight passes
execution.pass_route: Name the next task or closeout action
execution.fail_route: Name the approved fallback task or stop for Product Owner decision
execution.retry_policy: No retry unless the envelope explicitly permits a bounded retry
execution.estimated_duration: Provide an active-time range and expected human wait
